Meetings can be paused on Android, and filing a recording works the way it does on iOS.

- **Pause and resume a meeting** (#669). A Pause button sits next to Stop. While paused nothing reaches the audio file or live transcription and the timer stands still; Resume continues the same recording and transcript. Stop and Discard work from paused.
- **Filing: select, then confirm** (#670). Tapping a folder selects it and Save files the recording, matching iOS (#667). Organization folders get their own sections in the picker, and Move to… is in the recording's header and first in the row menu.
- **Screens clear the system bars** (#668). Content no longer sits under the navigation bar, the status bar or the camera cutout (the privacy link on sign-in, Import, and the live meeting's Discard were covered on some phones).
- **Library** (#668). Swiping between folders is a native pager that follows your finger, and the library reloads whenever you come back to it, so the top-bar refresh button is gone.
- **A refused upload is never deleted** (#628). A recording the server refuses is parked with its audio and retried after 1 h, 6 h and 24 h, then on request; before, some refusals deleted the only copy. Live transcription also keeps redialling instead of giving up after eight failed reconnects.
